## Testing Mode
UPDATE

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- DD3: When this story is complete, unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## TDD Requirement
Write a failing test that asserts `_flock_write_json` is callable from ticket-lib.sh and performs atomic JSON file writes with cross-platform locking. The test must FAIL (RED) before the function is added to ticket-lib.sh.

## Test Approach
Given: ticket-lib.sh is sourced in a test, and a temporary directory exists for the lock file and target file
When: `_flock_write_json <lock_file> <staging_temp> <final_path>` is called with a pre-staged JSON file
Then: the function atomically renames staging_temp to final_path while holding an exclusive lock; exit code 0; final_path contains the expected JSON content

Failure modes to test:
- Lock timeout: when another process holds the lock and never releases, `_flock_write_json` exits 1 after timeout
- Missing staging file: exits non-zero with error message to stderr
- Non-existent lock directory: exits non-zero (cannot create lock file)

## Implementation Notes
- Add test function `test_flock_write_json_atomic_write` to `tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib.sh`
- Add test function `test_flock_write_json_lock_timeout` to `tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib.sh`
- Add test function `test_flock_write_json_missing_staging_file` to `tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib.sh`
- Source ticket-lib.sh in the test (it is already sourced in tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib.sh)
- Use `mktemp` for all temp paths (never hardcoded names, per CLAUDE.md rule 15)
- Use `FLOCK_STAGE_COMMIT_TIMEOUT` env var to set short timeouts for lock-contention tests
- The test must fail because `_flock_write_json` does not yet exist in ticket-lib.sh

## RED Marker
Update `.test-index` with RED marker:
- Add `[test_flock_write_json_atomic_write]` to the `plugins/dso/scripts/ticket-lib.sh` entry

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Test file `tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib.sh` contains `test_flock_write_json_atomic_write` function
  Verify: grep -q 'test_flock_write_json_atomic_write' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib.sh
- [ ] Test asserts on observable outcome (file content after atomic rename), not internal state
  Verify: grep -qv '_flock_write_json.*called\|internal' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib.sh
- [ ] Test currently FAILS (RED) — `_flock_write_json` does not exist in ticket-lib.sh
  Verify: ! bash $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/tests/scripts/test-ticket-lib.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAILED: 0'
- [ ] `.test-index` updated with RED marker `[test_flock_write_json_atomic_write]` for ticket-lib.sh
  Verify: grep '\[test_flock_write_json_atomic_write\]' $(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.test-index
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$($(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && bash -c "$LINT_CMD" || true
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$($(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)/.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && bash -c "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" || true

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
